# encar-api-examples

> Code examples (curl, Python, JavaScript, PHP) for apiauto.space: a read-only REST API with used-car listings from Encar (South Korea), Che168 (China), Copart and IAAI (USA) in one normalized JSON record format. Base URL https://api.apiauto.space/v1, header X-API-Key. A free one-day demo key (100 requests) comes from the Telegram bot https://t.me/apiautospace_bot?start=demo. Not affiliated with Encar, Che168 (Autohome), Copart or IAAI.

Key facts:

- Markets: `kr` = Encar, `cn` = Che168, `us` = Copart and IAAI (lots with auctions ahead).
- Endpoints: GET /v1/cars (filters brand, model, generation, trim, year_min, year_max, price_min, price_max, price_usd_min, price_usd_max, mileage_max, fuel, transmission, body_type, has_photos, is_active, q; sort; cursor pagination; limit up to 100, 20 on the demo), GET /v1/cars/{id}, GET /v1/changes (added, disappeared, price_drop, price_up since a moment), GET /v1/references/{brands,models,dictionaries,markets}, GET /v1/usage, GET /v1/us/live.
- Quota counts returned cars, not requests. References, usage and photos are free.
- Server-side only: CORS is off.
- Client libraries: `pip install apiauto-space` (https://github.com/apiauto-space/apiauto-python), `npm i apiauto` (https://github.com/apiauto-space/apiauto-js).
